title: Spectral-Aware Analytic Class-Incremental Learning for Long-Tailed Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2607.22931v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Analytic Continual Learning (ACL) offers a computationally efficient alternative to gradient-based approaches. Recent ACL methods are based on Recursive Least Squares (RLS) and have achieved the state-of-the-art results compared to other alternatives. However, they falter significantly in Class-Incremental Learning scenarios characterized by Long-Tailed distributions. While the ill-conditioning of the autocorrelation (Gram) matrix is a known limitation of RLS, we demonstrate that class imbalance exacerbates this issue into a distinct spectral pathology: "tail" classes suffer from severe spectral collapse, rendering their subspaces numerically indistinguishable from noise. Standard Ridge Regression ($L_2$) fails to address this effectively as it applies isotropic regularization - a uniform penalty that is insufficient to stabilize the tail without over-shrinking the head. translated_title: 面向长尾分布的频谱感知解析式类增量学习
translated_abstract: 解析式持续学习为基于梯度的方法提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。近期的解析式持续学习方法基于递归最小二乘法（RLS），与其他替代方法相比取得了最先进的成果。然而，在以长尾分布为特征的类增量学习场景中，这些方法的表现会显著下降。尽管自相关（Gram）矩阵的病态性是RLS的一个已知局限，我们证明类别不平衡会将这一问题加剧为一种独特的频谱病理现象：“尾部”类别会遭受严重的频谱坍缩，使其子空间在数值上与噪声无法区分。标准岭回归（L2正则化）无法有效解决这一问题，因为它采用的是各向同性的正则化——一种统一的惩罚，不足以在不过度收缩头部类别的情况下稳定尾部类别。为解决这一问题，我们提出了几何-频谱矫正方法。（注：摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示长尾分布会使解析式类增量学习中的尾部类别发生“频谱坍缩”，并据此提出几何-频谱矫正方法，以克服标准岭回归各向同性正则化的不足，在不损害头部类别的前提下稳定尾部类别。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that long-tailed class imbalance causes severe spectral collapse of tail classes in analytic class-incremental learning, and proposes Geometry-Spectral Rectification to overcome the limitation of isotropic Ridge regularization, stabilizing tail classes without over-shrinking head classes.
